title: Explicit Reasoning Makes Better Judges: A Systematic Study on Accuracy, Efficiency, and Robustness
reasoning: The paper is a systematic technical study of LLMs used as judges in evaluation tasks. While it evaluates 'Safety' and 'Bias' using RewardBench, these are addressed as technical model alignment and consistency issues rather than as a study or benchmarking of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or philosophical/theological ethics.
